proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C H hBC hiso hH hperp
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hH
  have hd0 : ‖C -ᵥ B‖ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [norm_ne_zero_iff]; exact vsub_ne_zero.mpr hBC.symm
  set d : V := C -ᵥ B with hd
  set h : V := A -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap B C x with hh
  have hBH : AffineMap.lineMap B C x -ᵥ B = x • d := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub]
  have hHC : AffineMap.lineMap B C x -ᵥ C = (x - 1) • d := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, sub_smul, one_smul, hd, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev C B]
    abel
  have e1 : A -ᵥ B = h + x • d := by rw [← hBH, hh, vsub_add_vsub_cancel]
  have e2 : A -ᵥ C = h + (x - 1) • d := by rw [← hHC, hh, vsub_add_vsub_cancel]
  have hsq := congrArg (· ^ 2) hiso
  simp only [dist_eq_norm_vsub V A B, dist_eq_norm_vsub V A C, e1, e2, norm_add_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right, hperp,
    norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs] at hsq
  have hx : x = 1 / 2 := by
    have hpos : ‖d‖ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hd0
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hpos
    linear_combination (1 / 2) * hsq
  rw [hx, show (1 / 2 : ℝ) = ⅟2 by norm_num]
  rfl
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C H : P), B ≠ C → dist A B = dist A C → H ∈ line[ℝ, B, C] → inner ℝ (A -ᵥ H) (C -ᵥ B) = 0 → H = midpoint ℝ B C
